_readme: Game-mode kill list. Flip enabled to true once you've reviewed the list. Only processes named here are ever closed; system/Riot/Vanguard processes are protected no matter what. Graceful close by default (apps can prompt to save); add "force": true per entry ONLY if you accept losing its unsaved state. trigger: "launch" = when the Shotcaller shortcut starts, "gamestart" = at the loading screen. Test with: npm start -- --game-mode --boost-dry-run
